matrix.name: Matrix
matrix.description: Current-state organizer — ingests Catalyst (perturbation), produces Experience (update). Consolidates Pattern/Practice/Inventory/Threshold/Foundation entry types via intra-DB hierarchies (Parent, Blocked By) and inter-DB links (Generated From Potentiator, Integrated Into Significator).

potentiator.name: Potentiator
potentiator.description: Latent-state generator — ingests Experience, produces crystallized Catalyst. Consolidates Activity/Subjective/Relational/Systemic/Diet/Financial/Observation entry types. Crystallized entries link back to Matrix via Reveals/Crystallized To.

significator.name: Significator
significator.description: Persistent identity-pattern — ingests Transformation, emits Choice. Consolidates Purpose/Value/Principle/Identity-Statement/Pillar/Strategic-Ideal/Person/Group entry types via intra-DB hierarchies (Sub-item, Parent item, In Tension With) and inter-DB links (Anchored In Matrix, Transforms To GreatWay).

greatway.name: GreatWay
greatway.description: Operating environment — ingests Choice, produces Transformation. Consolidates Annual Goal/Quarterly Goal/Goal/Project/Task/System/Resource/Sprint/Milestone/Budget/Campaign/Content entry types via intra-DB hierarchies (Parent item, Sub-item) and inter-DB links (For Significator, Sourced From Nexus).

nexus.name: Nexus
nexus.description: Contact-boundary where all 4 currencies transmute. Consolidates Opportunity/Strength/Directive/Risk/Insight/Reflection/Integration/Pattern entry types. The Kind property tags each entry with the currency being transmuted (Catalyst/Experience/Transformation/Choice). Links to all 4 reservoirs (Tension→Significator, Counter-Tension→GreatWay, Sourced From→Potentiator, Updates→Matrix).
